frames.narration: Here we go, folks. This is the briefing for Period ten, week four, District eight. Thirty-six hours across twenty sets this week, with the cosmetics resets and Pet Care doing most of the heavy lifting. Checkpoints come along the way, and yes, they count.

frames.title: This Week at a Glance
frames.narration: Here is the whole week on one screen. Grocery carries eight sets, Health Beauty Care carries five, cosmetics carries two, Deli and Bakery carries two, Natural Foods carries two, and the fuel kiosk is one more. The biggest sets are Baby Food at seven hours and Sports Nutrition at six. Five sets run cold, and every cold set has a twenty-minute limit on product out of the case.

frames.narration: Starting with grocery. Coffee and Creamers is two hours of seasonal adds, and they land all over the set: natural, bag, end caps, instant and can, and Starbucks. Refrigerated Juices and Refrigerated Coffee Creamers are one hour each and run cold, with the twenty-minute limit. The creamers are seasonal swaps. Canned Vegetables and Canned Tomatoes are two hours each, Aseptic Drinks and Indian Foods are one hour each, and all four are new items only.

frames.narration: Health Beauty Care starts with Baby Food, seven hours, and that number comes from the test store, which ran over the estimate. The jar and tub section that leads the set gets condensed, with Gerber and Beechnut jars together, and pouches and snacks expand into the space. The flow only changes where tubs and jars lead the set, and value and Hispanic stores keep their expanded jar section. Expect a lot of vertical movement in pouches and snacks. Gerber tubs lose most of their product, and the tubs that stay gain facings. Here is the part that matters: check your planogram before you start cutting in. Smaller sets get tub shelf height changes, and shelf five drops one inch in most mainstream sets. Store four five nine gets Natural Foods baby strips, and those get recorded under Baby Food.

frames.narration: Sports Nutrition is six hours. On twelve-foot and larger sets, the single-serve protein shakes move above the multipacks, and there is a lot of vertical movement in the single-serve items, Celsius, Core Power, and Oikos. Atkins gets cut back, and what stays moves to the bottom shelves. Pure Protein multipacks will have holes, since some of those items are not being received right now. Stores twenty-three and twenty-eight move to a new store-specific sixteen-foot planogram. The Live Fit racks are part of this set too, and they show on the manifest at nineteen, twenty-three, fifty-three, two one five, three nine one, six five eight, and six eight two. Natural Foods Protein Powders is two hours. On four-foot and smaller sets it reflows, with shakes moving up and powders moving down to the bottom shelves. Most of the movement is vertical, and the same Pure Protein holes apply.

frames.narration: Pet Care is the priority set this week. It is one hour on paper and Compass at all ten District eight stores, and most stores get planogram conversions. It also changes department, from department zero one to department zero three. Cat scratcher versions get remapped at nineteen, twenty-eight, thirty-one, fifty-three, two one five, three nine one, and six five eight. The planograms are in A Useful Folder. Wild Bird Food strips show up at twenty-three, thirty-one, fifty-three, and three nine one, and those get recorded under Pet Care.

frames.narration: Cosmetics, starting with Implements and Brushes, two hours. Here is your action item for the week. Do not start this reset without the replacement tray in hand, and you have the okay to delay completion until it shows up. The acrylic rack at the bottom of the set comes out, and a new PM Plastics universal tray goes in its place. The tray boxes shipped FedEx with a hold sticker that reads Hold Compass Reset, or a hold for the cosmetics reset crew. If the store can't find one, check with the cosmetics clerk for a spare, then let me know. Pretty Savvy items become Kroger brand, and the old items stay on the peg while there is still product. Universal Fixture stores get full sets of tray labels, and fold one corner down when you put them on.

frames.narration: Cotton is two hours. Several items move to new S-R-P, and the old S-R-P stays in place while it still has product. Shelf moves are minimal, and pushers for the cotton swab shelf are included as fixture needs where stores were missing them. The cotton, nail, and implement combo planograms drop the artificial nail and brush pegs and become cotton and implements only. First Aid strips get recorded under Cotton. Tray labels likely won't arrive for this set, so follow store custom, either U-P-Ls on the trays or cut-down paper strips.

frames.narration: Bread is two hours. Stores twenty-three, thirty-one, and six five eight convert to the Artisan with Asian planogram, so grab that version. Keep the branded rack strips in place, like the Artisan Bread rack, and do not install Compass strips on those racks; use them only as a reset guide. On a bakery table, the new planogram goes in the plastic sleeve on the table. Everywhere else, the printed planogram goes to the Bakery department.

frames.narration: Fuel kiosks are two hours at nineteen, twenty-eight, thirty-one, fifty-three, two one five, three nine one, four five nine, and six eight two. The window wrap-around racks run customer-facing, left to right, and the lighters always sit on the right when you face the kiosk from outside. R-E-Z tags are wrapped separately. Compass does not move product between the store and the fuel center in either direction. Ask store management to bring the new product out, and the fuel center handles the disco and backstock. Cigarettes is one hour, the fuel tobacco sets reset alongside it, and Other Tobacco strips get recorded under Cigarettes.

frames.narration: Four quick maintenance sets at a quarter hour each: Frozen Vegetables, Hand Body Face, Hummus and Salsa, and Natural Foods Frozen Handheld, which carries the frozen handheld strips too. Three of those run cold, with the twenty-minute limit. One callout on mapping surveys: there are no oyster shelves. White is really only in health and beauty, and most shelves are Sahara, which is beige, or Clear Coat, which is a silvery gray. Pull the color guide before you call it.

frames.narration: Looking ahead to next week, about thirty-three hours. The updates are Baked Bread at six hours, Frozen Bread at five, Traditional Asian at four, and Salad Mix at two. Salad Mix is a produce set, so it gets done first thing, and the salad identifier cards move with the product. Energy Drinks loses a stack of Red Bull, and smaller brands move up to the top two shelves. In Upper Respiratory, Allegra moves off the bottom shelf and trades places with Benadryl. In Premium Juice, the Suja racks stay put. After that, Period eleven, weeks two and three, are blackout weeks at zero hours.

frames.narration: That is the week. Implements waits for the tray. Pet Care is the priority, with scratcher remaps at seven stores. Check the Baby Food planogram before you cut in. Twenty-three, thirty-one, and six five eight get the Artisan with Asian bread planogram. The store brings fuel product out to the kiosk, not us.
